title.value: Sustainability using Renewable Electricity (SuRE) towards NetZero Emissions
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the focus on sustainability using renewable electricity to achieve net-zero emissions, which is central to the paper.
title.quote: Sustainability using Renewable Electricity (SuRE) towards NetZero Emissions

extractions.description: The paper presents a scalable AI-based solution to help organizations increase their renewable electricity consumption, providing energy demand forecasts and carbon offset recommendations to achieve Net-Zero emissions. It focuses on optimizing the use of renewable energy in commercial buildings through predictive analytics.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's focus on increasing renewable energy share and reducing carbon emissions explicitly targets sustainable development goals related to climate mitigation and energy transition.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: As a step towards achieving Net-Zero emission target, we present a scalable AI based solution that can be used by organizations to increase their overall renewable electricity share in total energy consumption.

primary_category.justification: The primary theme is reducing carbon footprints through increased renewable energy use, aligning with climate change mitigation efforts.
primary_category.quote: To achieve Net-Zero emissions by 2050, major portion of this reduction is hence attributed to come by increasing the renewable energy share in the overall consumption.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper discusses reducing carbon emissions, which is directly related to pollution control.
secondary_categories.quote: Growth in energy demand poses serious threat to the environment since majority of the energy sources are non-renewable and based on fossil fuels, which leads to emission of harmful greenhouse gases.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper discusses optimizing renewable electricity consumption in buildings, a core aspect of grid optimization for renewables.
primary_sub_category.quote: The SuRE application provides AI based models for energy demand forecasting which in turn is used for optimal recommendation for procurement of green power.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions directly contributes to reducing air pollution.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Growth in energy demand poses serious threat to the environment since majority of the energy sources are non-renewable and based on fossil fuels, which leads to emission of harmful greenhouse gases.

applications.value: Energy demand forecasting for commercial buildings to optimize renewable electricity use.
applications.justification: The paper outlines an AI-based model for forecasting energy demand to optimize the use of renewable electricity in commercial buildings.
applications.quote: The SuRE application provides AI based models for energy demand forecasting which in turn is used for optimal recommendation for procurement of green power and help in creating a plan for achieving carbon emission reduction.
